A.depoimento: I trained two spearman in Lisboa and sent all my spearman to Santarem and all my knights to Evora to capture the two neutral villages, retaining my archers at home for defense and future production.
A.plano: Next turn we expect to hold Santarem and Evora. Use their resources to reinforce garrisons and continue building spearman (counter to knights). Prepare to push along the road network toward the enemy capital while keeping a strong defensive core in Lisboa.

B.depoimento: This turn I recruited two spearmen at Barcelona and dispatched five spearmen to Tarragona and one knight to Girona to seize the neutral villages.
B.plano: Next turn, gather income from Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona; train additional spears; reinforce captured villages; prepare to march on Zaragoza.

A.depoimento: This turn we dispatched 3 spearmen from Santarem to Coimbra, 2 archers from Lisboa to Faro, and 1 knight from Evora to Badajoz, while training 2 spearmen in Lisboa. We aim to seize the three visible neutrals and expand our control.
A.plano: Next turn we expect to hold Coimbra if our spearmen win. Use its resources to reinforce garrisons and continue building spearmen (counter to knights). Prepare to push along the road toward Badajoz and Faro as their armies arrive. Keep a strong defensive core in Lisboa and Santarem.

B.depoimento: Turn 2: I took Castellon with three spears from Tarragona, seized Zaragoza with a knight from Barcelona, and captured Huesca with four archers from Barcelona. I also ordered a new knight in Barcelona for future pushes. Our northeastern flank is now secured.
B.plano: Next turn, garrison Zaragoza with surviving troops; continue building knights in Barcelona; prepare to march on Valencia from Zaragoza/Girona; watch for enemy armies emerging from Lisboa.

A.depoimento: Today I dispatched a knight from Faro to take Badajoz and two archers from Lisboa to seize Porto, aiming to secure two key neutral villages. Simultaneously, I ordered a new knight in Lisboa, an archer in Santarem, and two spearmen in Evora to reinforce our armies for the next expansion wave.
A.plano: Next turn we expect to hold Badajoz and Porto if our attacks succeed. Use their resources to build more troops, especially archers and spearmen, to push toward Salamanca and Sevilha. Keep a strong defensive core in Lisboa and Santarem.

A.depoimento: I focused on building troops in Coimbra and Faro to prepare for upcoming offensives, while holding my core villages. No attacks were launched this turn as I prioritized force production.
A.plano: Next turn, send Coimbra's new knight and archer with its spearmen to capture Salamanca, use Faro's archers to take Sevilha, and reinforce Porto for a future Vigo assault. Keep Lisboa and Evora as secure bases.

B.depoimento: We marched from Barcelona with two spearmen and two knights, overcoming Valencia's neutral garrison and claiming the village. Our home villages began training new troops to replace losses and strengthen the front. The eastern coast is now within our grasp.
B.plano: Continue building knights in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Zaragoza; spearman in Castellon; archer in Huesca. After Valencia falls, reinforce it with incoming troops. Prepare to attack Murcia from Valencia or Castellon next turn.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered a massive buildup of spearmen in all my villages, preparing for a strong offensive push against the neutral territories.
A.plano: Next turn, send accumulated spearmen from multiple villages to capture Salamanca and Sevilha. Aim to secure at least two new villages to expand our base.

B.depoimento:
We sent four archers from Huesca to assault the neutral village of Murcia.
If victorious, this will expand our control along the eastern coast.
B.plano:
After capturing Murcia, garrison it with archers.
Rebuild archers in Huesca to replace losses.
Prepare next move toward Teruel via Valencia.

A.depoimento: Our armies struck swiftly: Coimbra took Salamanca, Badajoz claimed Toledo, and Faro secured Sevilha. We reinforced our realms with fresh archers and spearmen, readying for the next expansion.
A.plano: Next turn, consolidate gains, defend new villages, and prepare to capture Vigo using archers from Porto and Faro. Continue building archers in iron-rich towns and spearmen elsewhere. Do not overextend by attacking strong neutral forces without proper troop composition.

A.depoimento: This turn I fortified Coimbra with a spearman and an archer, prepared a knight in Lisboa and Santarem, and sent a small Porto force to bolster the upcoming assault on Salamanca. My marching army from Coimbra is en route to take Salamanca next turn.
A.plano: Next turn, I expect to capture Salamanca with my marching army and reinforce it with Porto's troops. Coimbra will then have enough archers to strike Vigo. I will continue building knights in iron-rich towns for a future push toward Cordoba, while consolidating Toledo and Sevilha and scouting the road to Madrid.

B.depoimento: We marched troops from Tarragona and Castellon to Valencia to concentrate a spear-heavy army. No building this turn, saving resources for future reinforcements. Next turn we will assault Teruel with overwhelming numbers.
B.plano: Gather spear-heavy force in Valencia from Tarragona and Castellon to attack Teruel next turn. Keep resources unused for now; avoid splitting forces or attacking other neutrals.

B.depoimento: I trained four archers in Valencia and sent its veteran spearmen and a knight to seize Teruel from the enemy.
B.plano: Next turn, Valencia will have 4 newly built archers plus the arriving reinforcement (1 spearman, 1 knight). Use this force to attack Murcia, relying on archers as the most numerous type to gain the counter bonus against its spearmen garrison.

A.depoimento: This turn I directed each village to train troops using local resources, creating a balanced force of spearmen, archers and knights. I held my current positions and postponed any attacks until we have sufficient strength to take the neutral villages and press the enemy.
A.plano: Build up troops for future offensives: focus on spearmen at Toledo and Salamanca, archers at Porto and Sevilha, knights at Lisboa and Evora. Next turn reinforce Toledo and prepare to attack neutral villages Madrid, Vigo, Cordoba and enemy Teruel. Do not attack this turn due to insufficient forces.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent Valencia's spearmen, archers and a knight to take Murcia, while dispatching Zaragoza's knights to reinforce Teruel. I also ordered archers in Valencia and Huesca and spearmen in Zaragoza for future pushes.
B.plano: Next turn, expect to capture Murcia; Valencia will have newly built archers ready. Zaragoza's spearmen will be ready to reinforce or attack Madrid. Hold Teruel's defenses and prepare to move toward Burgos after securing Murcia.

A.depoimento: Ordered construction of spearmen, knights, and archers across our realms. Launched assaults on Madrid and Teruel, and dispatched archers toward Vigo. Strengthened defenses while expanding our front.
A.plano: We are attacking Madrid and Teruel this turn to capture them; archers sent to Vigo will arrive next turn for future capture. Built troops to replenish garrisons and prepare for future offensives. Did not attack Cordoba this turn due to insufficient knight numbers; will prepare knights for next turn.

B.depoimento: This turn I reinforced Zaragoza with new archers and spearmen, preparing to strike at Madrid next turn. I held Teruel steady to guard against Toledo, and began building archers in Huesca for future offensives.
B.plano: Next turn, send 5 archers from Zaragoza to Madrid to capture it. Keep Teruel garrisoned to defend against Toledo. Continue building archers in Huesca for future Toledo attack. Do not send troops from Teruel yet.

B.depoimento: I launched six archers from Huesca to take Teruel, while sending two spearmen from Zaragoza to shore up Castellon. Across the realm, I ordered new archers and knights to ready our forces for the next push.
B.plano: Next turn, I will assess the outcome of the Teruel attack and reinforce any gains. I must keep Valencia and Murcia stocked with archers to deter enemy raids. I will not commit my knights from Girona until the eastern flank is secure.

A.depoimento: I sent Toledo's spearman and knight to bolster Teruel's defenses. Madrid's troops marched on Zaragoza and seized it unopposed. Across the realm, I ordered the production of knights, preparing for the next push to expand my kingdom.
A.plano: Reinforce Teruel with Toledo's troops to defend against incoming enemy army. Capture Zaragoza using Madrid's forces to gain a village. Build knights in most villages to create a strong, mobile army for future assaults on Cordoba and Burgos. Keep reserves in interior villages for later deployment.

A.depoimento: This turn I focused on building up my armies. I ordered 4 knights and 6 archers to be produced in Zaragoza, preparing for a major push on the front lines. No troops were sent this turn.
A.plano: Next turn, send 2 knights from Teruel to Valencia, 2 knights from Zaragoza to Huesca, 2 knights from Zaragoza to Tarragona, and 6 archers from Zaragoza to Pamplona. Aim to capture these four villages by turn 18 and hold them for two consecutive turns.

B.depoimento: We struck at Teruel with spearmen and archers from Castellon, reinforced by archers from Valencia. Simultaneously, we reinforced our eastern forts with new archers and knights, preparing for the next push toward Zaragoza and beyond.
B.plano: Capture Teruel this turn with combined forces from Castellon and Valencia. Leave garrisons in Castellon and Valencia. Build archers in Tarragona and Huesca for future Zaragoza assault, and knights in Girona and Barcelona for Cordoba. Avoid attacking Zaragoza until we have sufficient archer majority.

A.depoimento: Sent 2 knights from Toledo and 2 spearmen from Madrid to bolster Teruel. Launched an attack on Huesca with 3 knights, 2 archers, and 2 spearmen from Zaragoza. Maintained defenses elsewhere.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to capture Huesca and hold it. Defend Teruel against incoming enemy army using reinforcements from Toledo and Madrid. Build knights in Zaragoza and Toledo to replenish forces. Prepare to attack Valencia and Castellon from Teruel once reinforced.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent Valencia's archers to reinforce the attack on Teruel, while ordering new troops across the east. My garrisons hold the line as we prepare to strike Zaragoza and Cordoba. The march to Teruel proceeds, hoping for a swift victory.
B.plano: Try to capture Teruel with the Valencia archers and the marching Castellon force. Keep garrisons strong in border villages. Do not attack Zaragoza yet; continue building archers in Tarragona and Huesca and knights in Girona and Barcelona for future offensives.

A.depoimento: I built a knight in Zaragoza and two spearmen in Toledo. I sent all available troops from Zaragoza to reinforce Teruel and to strike at Valencia. I also dispatched a mixed force from Zaragoza toward Castellon for a future assault.
A.plano: Next turn, expect Valencia to fall. Defend Teruel against enemy counterattack using incoming reinforcements from Zaragoza and Madrid. Continue building knights in Zaragoza and spearmen in Toledo. Prepare the en route force for Castellon assault. Do not split Teruel's garrison again; do not launch a premature attack on Castellon.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent a force of 5 archers and 2 knights from Sevilha to capture Cordoba. I built two knights in Valencia and two archers in Zaragoza to strengthen our offensive capacity. I held my borders and awaited the arrival of reinforcements at Teruel.
A.plano: Next turn, expect Cordoba to be ours. Build knights in Valencia and archers in Zaragoza for future attacks on Murcia and Castellon. Hold Teruel with incoming reinforcements from Zaragoza. Prepare to defend against enemy counterattacks.

B.depoimento: We launch a coordinated strike: archers from Castellon take Teruel, spears from Castellon and Murcia seize Valencia, knights from Girona hit Zaragoza and Cordoba, and archers from Tarragona secure Pamplona. Simultaneously, we begin massing spears across our lands to prepare for the next pushes.
B.plano: Send archers to Teruel, spears to Valencia, knights to Zaragoza and Cordoba, archers to Pamplona. Build spears in all villages to reinforce future attacks and defense.

A.depoimento: Built 4 knights each in Teruel and Madrid. Sent reinforcements from Badajoz, Faro, and Coimbra to stockpile Cordoba and Madrid. Ready to launch assaults next turn.
A.plano: Next turn, attack Murcia with 4 knights,3 spearmen,3 archers from Cordoba; attack Zaragoza with 3 knights from Madrid; attack Valencia with 2 knights and Castellon with 1 knight from Teruel. Keep leftover troops for defense.

B.depoimento:
I ordered archers from Huesca and Zaragoza to march on Teruel and Madrid, aiming to capture both next turn.
I sent knights from Valencia to strengthen Castellon’s defenses.
I began building archers in Zaragoza and knights in Murcia to prepare for future offensives.
B.plano:
Send archers to capture Teruel and Madrid.
Reinforce Castellon with knights from Valencia.
Build archers in Zaragoza and knights in Murcia for future attacks.
Avoid splitting forces too thin; do not attack Cordoba yet.

B.depoimento:
I launched archer assaults on Teruel and knight strikes on Cordoba.
I began spearman production in Zaragoza for a future push on Madrid.
My forces are converging on the enemy's key positions.
B.plano:
Next turn, send the newly built spearmen from Zaragoza to Madrid to capture it.
Keep reinforcing border villages and avoid splitting forces too thin.
Do not attack Cordoba again until secured.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent Toledo's spearmen to Teruel, launched attacks on Valencia, Burgos, and Murcia, and ordered spearman production across my realms to strengthen my forces for the coming fight.
A.plano: Hold Teruel with reinforcements from Toledo; capture Valencia, Burgos, and Murcia; build spearmen in all villages to increase numbers; avoid overcommitting distant armies.

B.depoimento: I am reinforcing our border and launching a coordinated push on Teruel with troops from Valencia, Castellon, Zaragoza and arriving archers from Tarragona. Simultaneously I am preparing to strike Madrid and Cordoba while building up reserves.

A.depoimento: Sent spearmen from Toledo, Valencia, and Madrid to reinforce Teruel. Started mass spearman production across our lands to boost numbers. Secured our recent gains and readied for next turn.
A.plano: Hold Teruel with incoming reinforcements; continue building spearmen in all productive villages; watch enemy movements; prepare to press advantage if enemy weakens.

A.depoimento:
Sent eight spearmen from Teruel to assault Castellon.
Seizing this enemy village brings us to 18 held villages.
A.plano:
Capture Castellon this turn.
Next turn reinforce garrison and build archers.
Hold 18 villages for two turns.

A.depoimento: This turn I reinforced Madrid with spearmen and knights, built archers in several interior villages, and kept Valencia's garrison intact to prepare for next turn's assault on Castellon.
A.plano: Hold Valencia garrison, reinforce Madrid with troops from Toledo, Burgos, Salamanca. Build archers in key villages for future counter. Next turn send Valencia troops to Castellon to support Teruel spearmen attack, aim to capture Castellon and hold 18 villages for two turns.

A.depoimento: Sent reinforcements from interior villages to strengthen our borders and began mass-producing spearmen in all towns to boost future defenses.
A.plano: Continue reinforcing border villages (Teruel, Madrid, Castellon) and build spearmen everywhere to increase garrison. Avoid overbuilding any single village beyond 300 troops. Do not launch offensive unless enemy forces appear.

B.depoimento: This turn we focused on fortifying Tarragona and training archers. We pulled infantry from our interior villages to strengthen the border. Soon we’ll strike Castellon and gain a foothold against the enemy.
B.plano:
Build 20 archers in Tarragona this turn.
Reinforce Tarragona with infantry from Barcelona, Girona, Zaragoza, and Huesca.
Next turn, send the archers to attack Castellon.
